title: Optimal Account Balancing
description: Find the minimum number of transactions to settle all debts among a group of people.
pseudocode:
1. balance = getBalances(transactions)
2. debt = balance.filter(x => x != 0)
3. function dfs(idx):
4.   if idx == debt.length: return 0
5.   if debt[idx] == 0: return dfs(idx + 1)
6.   res = Infinity
7.   for i = idx + 1 to debt.length:
8.     if debt[i] * debt[idx] < 0:
9.       debt[i] += debt[idx]
10.      res = min(res, 1 + dfs(idx + 1))
11.      debt[i] -= debt[idx]
12.  return res
